title: 사회대개혁위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
title_original: 사회대개혁위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 7 (Meetings)
(1) The Chairperson shall convene meetings of the Committee and preside over them.
(2) Meetings of the Committee shall, in principle, be held every two months, and extraordinary meetings shall be held in any of the following cases:
1. Where at least one-third of the incumbent members request that a meeting be held;
2. Where the Chairperson otherwise deems it necessary to convene a meeting of the Committee.
(3) A meeting shall open with the attendance of a majority of the incumbent members, and resolutions shall be adopted with the affirmative votes of a majority of members present: Provided, That where a meeting is held in writing, a majority of the incumbent members shall submit written deliberation forms, and resolutions shall be adopted with the affirmative votes of a majority of the members who submitted such forms.
(4) Where necessary for the deliberation of agenda items, the Committee may invite the heads of relevant central administrative agencies, local governments, public institutions, research institutes, and other institutions or organizations, or relevant public officials and private experts, to attend meetings and express opinions.
